The Takeaway: In Block 3, the block average was only -0.003, well below the threshold of 0.004. Without token routing, that entire block was squashed into a coarse grey blur. With token routing ON, the kernel automatically promoted the top 64 outlier tokens to 100% exact precision, reducing the total attention error from 23.52% down to 21.14%!
